system.description: Leathery, batlike webbing stretches from beneath your arms down your sides, letting you glide short distances on an updraft or strong wind at your normal walking speed. You cannot actually fly or hover, cannot carry passengers, and only personal items may travel with you (Storyteller discretion). You need wind to glide; indoors or in still air you simply drop. When gliding, hold your arms out at your sides and wear a tag indicating your unusual appearance. Consult the Storyteller before taking this Merit.
system.source: Clanbook: Nosferatu, Chapter Two: Inside Clan Nosferatu
